youtube_full.title: Cords of Love | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Hosea 11:4
youtube_full.description:
Cords of Love: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Hosea 11:4.

Hosea’s people had wandered away from Heavenly Father. So Heavenly Father told them how much He still loved them.

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Wren the Wonderer.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: Cords of Love
1:10 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Wren the Wonderer
1:48 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
2:56 Question time
3:14 Sweet dreams
3:31 More stories, the app and the paperback
